title: Make a simple coleslaw from a recipe
summary: The person reads a recipe on a tablet, pulls a bowl from the dishwasher, grabs a whisk from the pantry and opens the knife drawer. Shredded cabbage is nearby, so this is likely a slaw with whisked dressing. The task is uncertain.

nodes.name: Review the recipe
nodes.instruction_novice: Read through the recipe on your tablet once before starting. Note every ingredient and tool you need.
nodes.end_state: The tablet shows the recipe at the top of the stove.

checks.question: Is this step done: Review the recipe?

nodes.name: Get a mixing bowl
nodes.instruction_novice: Take a clean bowl from the dishwasher or cabinet. Set it on a flat, cool surface.
nodes.end_state: A clean pink bowl sits on the cool stovetop or counter.

checks.question: Is this step done: Get a mixing bowl?

nodes.name: Gather tools from pantry
nodes.instruction_novice: Grab the whisk and any measuring spoons or cups the recipe calls for.
nodes.end_state: The whisk and measuring tools lie next to the bowl.

checks.question: Is this step done: Gather tools from pantry?

nodes.name: Get a knife and board
nodes.instruction_novice: Choose a sharp knife from the drawer and set out a cutting board.
nodes.end_state: A knife rests on a cutting board on the counter.

checks.question: Is this step done: Get a knife and board?

nodes.name: Gather dressing ingredients
nodes.instruction_novice: Take the mayo, vinegar, sugar and seasonings from the fridge and pantry. Line them up near the bowl.
nodes.end_state: Condiment jars and seasonings are lined up beside the bowl.

checks.question: Is this step done: Gather dressing ingredients?

nodes.name: Shred remaining vegetables
nodes.instruction_novice: Thinly slice any remaining cabbage, then grate or slice the carrots. Keep your fingers curled away from the blade.
nodes.end_state: A pile of thin cabbage and carrot shreds sits on the plate or board.

checks.question: Is this step done: Shred remaining vegetables?

nodes.name: Measure dressing into bowl
nodes.instruction_novice: Measure each dressing ingredient carefully and add it to the bowl.
nodes.end_state: The dressing ingredients sit unmixed in the bowl.

checks.question: Is this step done: Measure dressing into bowl?

nodes.name: Whisk the dressing
nodes.instruction_novice: Whisk until smooth with no streaks. Taste it and adjust the salt or sugar.
nodes.end_state: A smooth, uniform dressing fills the bottom of the bowl.

checks.question: Is this step done: Whisk the dressing?

nodes.name: Toss vegetables with dressing
nodes.instruction_novice: Add the shredded vegetables to the dressing. Toss until everything is evenly coated.
nodes.end_state: The cabbage is evenly coated with dressing in a larger bowl.

checks.question: Is this step done: Toss vegetables with dressing?

nodes.name: Chill before serving
nodes.instruction_novice: Cover the bowl and refrigerate it for at least 30 minutes so the flavors blend.
nodes.end_state: The covered bowl is placed in the refrigerator.

checks.question: Is this step done: Chill before serving?

nodes.name: Clean up workspace
nodes.instruction_novice: Put the ingredients away and rinse the tools. Wipe down the counter.
nodes.end_state: The counter is clear and the tools are in the sink or dishwasher.

checks.question: Is this step done: Clean up workspace?
